messages:
alana: Heads-up — Elmwood (Private) switchover is tentatively scheduled for the quiet window tonight 02:30–03:30 UTC. Asking for a quick pin/rollback sanity check.

deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled cutover: elmwood-private -> v2.3.1-dedicated at 2024-12-02T02:30:00Z. Dry-run link: <https://deploy.redwood.io/dryrun/elmwood/1738881024> :robot_face:

mike: pinging SRE — can we confirm pre-priming for the tenant slice and that KV cache warming is in the runbook?

nina: security note: customer reported an inbound KMS rotation for their key at 02:00 UTC the same night. that'll overlap unless we shift. I can reach out to their SecOps but need ops consent first.

product-ops: If we shift the KMS rotation, do we still want the same rollback target? current fallback is v2.2.9-dedicated (non-quantized). Confirming fallback behavior: full traffic -> 50% -> 0 over 10 minutes?

alana: yes fallback to v2.2.9 is what we planned. rollback policy: immediate revert to pinned fallback on >5% error rate or latency p95 > 700ms for 5m. we can modify windows if needed.

sre-oncall: please add a preflight step to check KMS key state and a post-cutover sweep. I recommend changing the cutover to 03:00 UTC to avoid the 02:00 KMS rotation. Also request: hold canary at 5m / 10% traffic.

mike: +1 for 03:00. I'll update the slice priming job: ``rerun --tenant elmwood --warm-kv --timeout 1800`` and post results in this thread.

deploybot: [deploybot] Updated schedule: elmwood-private -> v2.3.1-dedicated at 2024-12-02T03:00:00Z. Canary config attached. Canary gates: latency p95 <= 450ms, error rate <= 1%. Link: <https://deploy.redwood.io/canary/elmwood/1738881024>

nina: I reached customer SecOps — they can shift KMS rotation to 04:00 UTC. they asked for the final cutover time to confirm their runbooks.

product-ops: ok locking 03:00 UTC then. two asks: 1) add explicit note about KMS check in the runbook, 2) ensure telemetry retention 48h for postmortem.

alana: added both to the runbook. runbook excerpt: ``- verify KMS key status: aws kms describe-key --key-id <id> && aws kms list-rotations --key-id <id>
- run: rerun --tenant elmwood --warm-kv --timeout 1800
- start cutover: deploybot trigger --tenant elmwood --version v2.3.1-dedicated --canary 10% 5m``

mike: priming done: KV warm success, mem usage stable. logs: ``priming: elmwood ok — 120k prefixes cached``. posting artifacts: <https://artifacts.redwood.io/elmwood/priming/1738881024>

sre-oncall: all good from infra. I'll be on-call for handover. prepping rollback playbook snippet: ``deploybot rollback --tenant elmwood --version v2.2.9 --ramp 50 5m``

alana: thanks everyone. marking this thread as approved for 03:00 UTC cutover. if anything changes please @channel. :white_check_mark:
